children.name: H2
children.characters: Hey, I'm Jaden. The go-to website designer in Miami, Florida.

children.name: Body
children.characters: I have come to realize that tall demands can only be fulfilled by capable people. Too often we sit with ideas instead of asking what we can actually make of them. Expectations keep rising, and I've made it my responsibility to meet them.

children.name: Body 2
children.characters: 18, designer and developer, Miami. Running Ocean Development, building websites for brands that refuse to settle for ordinary.

children.name: Step 1 body
children.characters: We map your goals, audience and positioning before a single pixel is designed.

children.name: Step 2 body
children.characters: Custom design in Figma, then built in Framer, Shopify or WordPress.

children.name: Step 3 body
children.characters: A Loom walkthrough at handoff, plus 30 days of email support after launch.

children.name: Step 4 body
children.characters: Ongoing improvements that keep your site converting as your brand grows.

children.name: Body
children.characters:
I started Ocean Development as a teenager, and I still work directly with every client. No account managers and no handoffs between a sales team and a design team.

You get the person who designs and builds your site on the call, in the files and at launch.
